summary: The driver now adds the current task to the gate sweep when the work session reports blocked (not only done), and when that gate passes it says so in the iteration's warning, the task's notes, and the run-end report, without changing the blocked status transition.
verified: ( . .loop/tests/lib.sh; ... ) && bash .loop/tests/scenarios/39-blocked-gate-passes.sh && .loop/tests/run-all.sh && uv run pytest -q — exit 0, 42 checks passed, 40 pytest tests passed.
notes: gate_targets now includes the current task on outcome==blocked as well as done (.loop/run.sh:994). A new blocked_gate_passed flag (true when outcome is blocked and the task is not in gate_failed) drives three call sites sharing one message string, gate_pass_line: the iteration's warn line inside the existing 'elif outcome==blocked' branch, a prefix prepended to the blocked-case notes ($summary is still appended verbatim after it, so the session's own report survives), and a run-end block gated on a new blocked_gate_pass_tasks array (initialized before the main loop, appended to only in that branch) printed right after per-phase cost, before the final status banner's case statement. Left the status transition, attempt charge and 'review not run for blocked' path untouched -- blocked_gate_passed never changes $outcome, only what gets said around it. A blocked task whose own gate FAILS is now also added to gate_targets and thus to gate_failed, but the existing regression loop already excludes id==task and the existing elif-chain checks outcome==blocked before candidate_failed, so neither GATE REGRESSION nor GATE FAIL fires for it -- no change needed there, verified against scenario 39's second case. Checked the existing suite for scenarios that report outcome blocked and could now trip an unintended gate run: 11-stall.sh's task verify (test -f T1.out) is never satisfied so its gate silently fails every iteration with nothing printed, matching its existing assertions; 17-stale-handoff.sh's T2 gets a no-proposal blocked outcome but its file (T2.out) happens to exist from an unconditional touch earlier in that stub, so its gate now passes too -- harmless since that scenario asserts specific log substrings only, not the absence of any gate-pass line.
